Message:
The cut on
Moineau’s hand gleamed red,
illuminated by
the full moon’s glow.

Not only could she not kill me,
she even got herself hurt
in the process...
It always ends up
like this, doesn’t it...?

A sudden noise rang out
from the floor below,

and Moineau ran out to
find its source, weapon in hand.

As I listened to the ensuing
echo of the clanging blades,
I found myself curling into a ball...
I truly am worthless...

After some time,
Moineau returned,
covered in a number
of fresh wounds...

Who cares if
she can’t feel pain...!
At this rate, she’ll...!

...It’s all my fault...
Because of me,
Moineau has to
suffer this much...!

The moment I realized
I was no longer loved...
I should have just died...

Instead...I got my hopes up...
Believing that one day,
they really would come to
take me back home...!

That’s why, despite knowing
I only ever hurt those around me...
I’ve stayed alive until now...
And this is the result...!

If it wasn’t for that promise,
all my suffering,
and all this tragedy,
would never have happened...!
So, why...?!

“If you were just
going to abandon me,
why did you make that promise?!
You only gave me false hope!”

Don’t give me any reasons
to wait for you...!
Just tell me...
you don’t want me anymore...!

If you’d only told me that,
I would have given up...
On being part of this family...
on love...and on my life...

Even those birds you sent me,
while I was all alone...
would have been spared...
